title: Omniscience of God
definition: The omniscience of God means that God perfectly knows all things: past, present, future, actual, possible, visible, hidden, and inward.
summary: God knows all things completely and perfectly.
christFocus: Jesus reveals divine knowledge, knowing hearts, needs, sins, and future events while caring for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's omniscience means nothing is hidden from Him. He knows every action, motive, thought, word, fear, need, sin, sorrow, and future event. His knowledge is complete and never learned by discovery.

This truth is both sobering and comforting. It exposes hypocrisy and hidden sin, but it also assures suffering believers that God sees what others miss.

Christ's knowledge of the heart shows that He is not fooled by appearances. Yet He uses His knowledge to call sinners, heal the broken, and shepherd His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often feel unseen, misunderstood, or tempted to hide sin. The omniscience of God matters because it teaches that God fully knows and still calls people to truth, repentance, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live honestly before God. Bring hidden sin, private fear, and unseen suffering to Him, knowing He already knows and is wise in His care.
